Hi Alice — thanks for the questions and for the sample. Answers / recommendations below; happy to dive deeper on the follow-up call.

Auth & SDK:
- We support API keys for server-to-server calls and short-lived OAuth 2.0 tokens for customers who want fine-grained rotation. For Dedicated/Private, we also offer mTLS and KMS-backed token provisioning. If you prefer OAuth, we can share a sample token exchange flow.

Routing & deployment:
- Yes — requests can be routed by policy. For evaluation on Redwood hosted, calls hit our shared inference fleet. When you move to Dedicated we can route reranker requests to your dedicated pool for isolation and consistent latency.

Batch ranking API (throughput notes):
- Our Rerank API supports batch endpoints that accept up to 1k queries in a single HTTP payload (depending on candidate volume). For 500 queries x 100 candidates we recommend chunking into 2-3 requests to avoid timeouts and to leverage parallelism.
- Default throttling: 100 concurrent rerank requests per org on hosted; we can increase for POC if needed. We'll work with your SRE on rate limits for larger jobs.

Structured outputs / evidence fields:
- Rerank responses can include structured evidence fields in the result objects (score, matched_passage, provenance_id). We also support an optional structured output mode where the model returns a JSON blob for each candidate (useful for reason/explanation). If you need deterministic tool-calling, reuse the structured output mode and validate with the output schema.

Top_k & evaluation suggestions:
- Start with top_k experiments at k = [5, 10, 20]. For the first pass track: Precision@k (P@5/P@10), Recall@k, nDCG@k, and Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR).
- For hyperparameter tuning: test candidate reordering (reranker-only) vs. hybrid score (alpha * retriever_score + beta * reranker_score). Alpha/beta grid of [0.0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0] is a good starting point.
- Significance testing: use paired bootstrap or t-test on nDCG to confirm improvements.

Practical integration snippets (SDK pseudocode):
- Fetch candidates (embedding retrieval) -> callRerankBatch(candidatesBatch) -> parse structured evidence -> merge into final ranking.
- Example:
  POST /v1/rerank/batch
  {
    "queries": [ {"id":"q1","candidates":[{"id":"d1","text":"...","retriever_score":0.78}, ...] }, ... ]
  }

- Response includes per-candidate score and optional "evidence" object (string) and "structured": { ... } if you request structured_output=true.

Next steps from Redwood side:
1) We'll validate your eval_sample.csv format (looks fine) and run an initial baseline with our standard reranker model.
2) Share a small results package (P@5,P@10,nDCG@5,nDCG@10,example failures) within 48-72 hours.
3) Schedule a 30-min sync for next Wed 6/17 — propose 10:00am PT; let us know if that works.
